scope: Independent bounded editorial review of20 bodies and10 article-to-original-source checks. No full-batch certification.

bodyChecks: Source-specific sudden pressure-drop interpretation is distinguished from steady low pressure. Recurrence condition limits the controller-replacement statement. No invented pressure-change-per-second interval.

Generic code is bounded to the reproduced BMW summary. Positive/negative correction directions remain distinct and closed-loop prerequisite is retained. No unsupported fuel-pressure or parts specification.
Missing reference events remain distinct from merely displaying RPM. Scope is N62TU; no invented waveform or air gap. Controller fallback behavior is separated from primary defects.

SMG test-group scope is not inferred from the E46 navigation model alone. Electrical high input is distinguished from actual hydraulic overpressure. Ambiguous supply notation is not converted into an invented enable range.
BMW manufacturer namespace and N62TU fault variant retained. DME-directed source action is bounded by exact identity and full workshop requirements. No unsupported sensor threshold or chip repair.

Reference-current fault is distinguished from a fuel-cap or tank-leak result. Original evidence is retained before the source-prescribed clearing/test sequence. Function-test conditions are explicitly not universal normal-operation detection conditions.

Circuit-high classification is separated from mechanical timing/VANOS performance. Combined table cells are not portrayed as a stand-alone pin test. No invented connector values or automatic actuator replacement.
Adaptation prerequisites and programming history are separated from throttle-body failure. No unsupported manual pedal sequence or bypass. Engine-control scope is explicit.

Commanded safety shutdown is distinguished from failed fuel delivery. Crash module diagnosis retained; no relay bridging or premature restoration instruction. Unexplained 750-second source field is explicitly not used as a reset delay.
High signal voltage is separated from actual pressure. Correct sensor/wiring scope and professional fuel-system boundary are stated; no unsafe opening or probing directions.
Open/short subtypes and their different ignition states are preserved. Does not diagnose every glow plug from relay circuit B. High-current work remains professional.
Reference-supply codes are prioritized before a pressure-sensor decision. Signal thresholds are separated from charging voltage. Refrigerant is not added by guesswork.
KJ high-input criterion and open-circuit possibility retained. NGC connector-adapter precaution avoids damaging terminals. Citation packaging issue was sent to the writer.

Catalog low-relay-sense wording is explicitly distinguished from the factory switched-battery procedure. Premature voltage is not misrepresented as low hydraulic pressure. No workshop relay-jumper steps are copied into the article.

Volkswagen manufacturer namespace retained. Substitute temperature is not treated as measured physical temperature. Engine-specific wiring branches and temperature-dependent resistance examples are bounded. Title spacing issue was sent to the writer.
Restriction and purge-monitor sequence are distinguished from an external leak. No compressed-air or fuel-vapor test instructions are provided. Cold-start context remains bounded.
Relay command, load observation and warning-lamp output-test stage are separated. No unsupported claim that a lamp/relay response proves every glow plug is healthy.
SKIM communication, module faults, VIN and individual key evidence remain separate. No bypass instructions; module replacement remains conditional and professional.
Actual pressure and false electrical feedback are separated through the source gauge comparison. Exclusion of five-speed 545RFE retained. Pressure testing/internal work remains professional.

Generic F label is mapped to MS only within the documented Jeep transmission. Related-code-dependent continuity logic is stated. Common relay power and external control wiring precede assembly assumptions.

verifiedClaims: Original image visually confirms signal >4.7 V and short-to-supply classification.

deepSourceChecks.sourceLocators: P1385 original HTML fields; related P1332/P1333 variant records
verifiedClaims: Original P1385 record maps 2E6B/P1385 to knock-sensor signal 4 and says Replace DME.

Final note says function-test conditions are not normal-operation detection conditions; article retains this distinction.

deepSourceChecks.sourceLocators: 11B004/P213F original HTML: accident message, memory persistence, service action and symptoms
verifiedClaims: Accident message commands electric fuel-pump shutdown.

Article does not provide bypass/restart instructions.
caveats: Unexplained 750-second time field is not interpreted as a reset or waiting period.

deepSourceChecks.sourceLocators: Original PDF physical pages188–189 (printed182–183), WRONG OR INVALID KEY MSG RECEIVED FROM SKIM
verifiedClaims: Communication check precedes SKIM codes, programmed VIN and module decisions.
Intermittent branch explicitly mentions recent SKIM disconnection/replacement and tests all customer keys, including non-SKIM duplicates.
Article states legitimate configuration/authorized-key diagnosis and omits bypass instructions.

deepSourceChecks.sourceLocators: Original PDF physical pages329–337 (printed321–329); page329 also visually rendered and inspected
verifiedClaims: Set condition includes sensed >3psi with requested0psi,95% duty and2.65-second conditions; article retains existence of the additional conditions without inventing a different threshold.

Gauge below3psi while scanner is high sends diagnosis to electrical paths; high gauge sends it to debris/hydraulic branch.

boundedLimitations: Only the exact20 listed articles received body review; later drafts and unsampled bodies were not reviewed.
Only the exact10 listed articles received deep source checking. Body-only pass does not independently verify every numeric claim against its source.

Sources are manufacturer-authored documents reproduced by public mirrors. This review checks the cited historical documents, not current manufacturer supersessions or compatibility with an individual VIN.
Ambiguous SMG supply notation and P213F750-second field remain excluded from actionable interpretation.
No vehicle testing, professional mechanic signoff, complete repair-procedure validation, publication or deployment was performed.
Generated manifests, shared source partitions and other review reports were not edited.
